## Bug Description
Provide a clear and concise description of the bug.

## Steps to Reproduce
1. Go to '...'
2. Click on '...'
3. Perform action '...'
4. Observe error

## Expected Behavior
What should have happened?

## Actual Behavior
What actually happened?

## Environment Information

**System:**
- Hardware: [e.g., MacBook Pro M2, Mac Studio M1 Ultra]
- macOS Version: [e.g., 15.1.1, 15.2]
- Sorty Version: [e.g., 1.0.5] (find in About menu)

**Configuration:**
- AI Provider: [e.g., OpenAI, Ollama, Apple Foundation Models]
- Model: [e.g., gpt-5.4-mini, llama3.1]
- Persona: [e.g., General, Developer, Custom]

## Diagnostic Information

**If applicable, check these items:**

- [ ] Can you reproduce the issue consistently?
- [ ] Does it occur with different AI providers?
- [ ] Does restarting the app resolve it?
- [ ] Does it occur with a different folder/persona?

**For AI-related issues, include:**
- Error message displayed (if any)
- Console.app logs (search for "Sorty")
- API response time (if visible in UI)

**For file operation issues, include:**
- Full path to affected folder
- File types involved
- File permissions (check Get Info in Finder)

**For Watched Folder issues:**
- Is the app running from /Applications?
- Was the folder recently moved or renamed?
- Console logs showing bookmark errors

## Screenshots or Logs
Add screenshots, screen recordings, or relevant log excerpts.

## Additional Context
Any other information that might help us understand the issue:
- Recent macOS updates
- Other apps accessing the same files
- Network configuration (VPN, proxies)
- File system type (APFS, external drive, network share)

## Checklist
Before submitting, please verify:
- [ ] I have checked the [Help documentation](https://github.com/sorty-organizer/Sorty/blob/main/HELP.md)
- [ ] I have checked existing issues (open and closed)
- [ ] This is not a security issue (use [private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/sorty-organizer/Sorty/security/advisories/new))
